title: Enitor command request
description: A keyed command request sent by Tasker, enitor-cli, MCP or the widget. See docs/integrations/formats.md, section 2. Unknown top-level fields and unknown args are allowed: Enitor does not reject them, it lists them in the reply's warnings.

v.description: Format version. Only version 1 exists; a newer version is refused with unsupported_version. A missing version means 1.

command.description: The command. Its args are checked by the matching rule below.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat with the same key within 7 days returns the first reply and creates nothing. Without a key every request is a new one.

args.description: Arguments of the command. Field rules are the same as for links: text is trimmed, dates and times use the formats below.

title.description: Title. After trimming, 1 to 500 characters (characters, not UTF-16 units).

longText.description: Free text, up to 5000 characters. A longer value is refused, not cut.

date.description: Local calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, within 5 years of today. Missing means today (before 04:00 'today' is still yesterday).

time.description: HH:MM, 00:00 to 23:59. A leading zero may be omitted (9:05). end must be later than start; this part is not expressible in JSON Schema and is checked by Enitor.

priority.description: Priority. Enitor also accepts any letter case; the lowercase spellings are listed here.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags of up to 40 characters, '#' is stripped. Enitor also accepts a comma-separated string.

addScheduleItemArgs.description: A schedule item needs a start time; end is optional.

id.description: Full task id, or a unique prefix of at least 4 characters. An ambiguous prefix is answered as not_found.

date.description: Day to list. Missing means today.
